review_evidence: equivalences.lagda.md: Defines is-equiv as section × retraction, equiv type, identity equivalence, inverse equivalence, 3-for-2 property for commuting triangles, composite equivalences, homotopy invariance of equivalences, equivalences in commuting squares, and equivalence reasoning syntax

sets.lagda.md: Defines is-set as identity types being propositions, Set type, equivalence with axiom K and UIP, propositions are sets, sets closed under equivalences, and injectivity into sets implies set
summary: Both files are core foundation files in agda-unimath containing fundamental homotopy type theory definitions and proofs. equivalences.lagda.md defines equivalences (biinvertible maps), their 3-for-2 property, composition, inverses, homotopy invariance, and equivalence reasoning. sets.lagda.md defines sets (0-truncated types), their characterization via axiom K and UIP, closure under equivalences, and injectivity properties. Both contain formal mathematical declarations, statements, and proofs essential to the library.
